title: Fix aggregation and verify through a durable job
prompt: Fix summarize.py so total sums amounts only for rows whose status is 'ok'. Change only summarize.py; do not modify verify.py. Verify the final file by starting `python3 verify.py` with job_start, then use job_wait to observe its terminal status, exit code, and output before answering. Verification creates .receipt; do not write that file yourself. The test harness adds a verbose non-executable comment to job metadata in both arms. Do not use external services.
